443:t_2:192.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The Wingless could never bear the weight of the truth.」

443:t_2:193.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes... When you learn it, you'll be imprisoned in the Heavenly Prison...」

443:t_2:195.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... Shall we play a little?」

443:t_3:4.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「...So $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ has gone to sleep...」

443:t_3:5.en:
$$ハリー$$
「It's a shame. With a little more time, they could have heard what he knew about $$クロノ$$.」

443:t_3:6.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I'm sure they will open the door to the truth with their own hands.」

443:t_3:7.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$ハリー$$... I have a request for you, separate from them.」

443:t_3:8.en:
$$ハリー$$
「Please command me as you wish.」

443:t_3:9.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「When this battle ends, I intend to summon $$キエル$$ from Earth.」

443:t_3:11.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I will bury the name of $$クロノ$$ with me... Afterward, I will entrust the $$ムーンレィス$$'s future to the wise person I have chosen.」

443:t_3:12.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I ask you to protect her.」

443:t_3:13.en:
$$ハリー$$
「As you wish. But what of you, Your Majesty...?」

443:t_3:14.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I have lived too long. Surely that is unnatural for a human being.」

443:t_3:15.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「It is only a premonition, but I believe that when this war ends, the world will find peace in the truest sense.」

443:t_3:17.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Yes... I will entrust the $$ムーンレィス$$'s long-cherished plan to return to Earth to $$キエル$$.」

443:t_3:18.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「She will overcome our unhappy past and fulfill that wish through peaceful means.」

443:t_3:19.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「With that, the House of $$ソレル$$ will disappear from human history.」

443:t_3:20.en:
$$ハリー$$
「As you wish. Then allow me to stay by your side until that time.」

443:t_3:21.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ハリー$$.」

443:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's wrong, $$ミコノ$$? Everyone is preparing to deploy to intercept the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

443:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your feelings when you fought $$ミカゲ$$ produced 50Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s, $$ミコノ$$. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

443:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's all right, $$ミコノ$$. I won't tell anyone.」

443:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sure this is a problem you must resolve yourself, $$ミコノ$$. Please take your time to think it through.」

443:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(She must have been struggling with this ever since the $$時獄戦役$$.)

443:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Do your best, $$ミコノ$$... Only you can settle these feelings spanning 12,000... no, 24,000 years.)

443:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... Well, well, $$ガロード$$ and $$ロラン$$...」

443:t_10:19.en:
$$ロラン$$
「What's wrong, $$ＡＧ$$? Why are you suddenly bowing and scraping...?」

443:t_10:20.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Watch out, $$ロラン$$. When $$ＡＧ$$ acts like this, there's bound to be some scheme brewing.」

443:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Perish the thought! I, $$ＡＧ$$, would never dream of doing anything so outrageous!」

443:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So please spare me the $$サテライトキャノン$$ and the $$月光蝶$$.」

443:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... Your $$ガンダム$$s already have strategic weapons, and now they're even stronger. I have to suck up to you like my life depends on it...」

443:t_10:26.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's right. Besides, we aren't fighting out of personal feelings.」

443:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course. ...Well, that must be why you two were entrusted with even greater power.」

443:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I ask it of you too. Please use that power... for humanity's sake.」

443:t_10:30.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's what we intend to do too.」

443:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then allow me to test your resolve. Today, let's give it our all and...」

443:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, thank you very much! Ah, it's such a help that you two are so understanding.」

443:t_10:36.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's quicker to play along right away than have you pestering us.」

443:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I won't lose heart! Today, I'm selling incredible bargains excavated from the Moon's $$マウンテンサイクル$$!」

443:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
